galaxy_setting.name: CapturableRepositioning_Enabled
galaxy_setting.description:
If enabled at the start of the game all immobile capturables (i.e. 天顶 Power Generators, Major Data Centers, etc) will be relocated to, with default or close settings, somewhere on the outter side of the gravity well and further away from wormholes. This reduces or outright prevents situations where an important capturable is unreasonable to get, simply because it is located between wormholes, bordering an AI 堡垒 world or similar.
By default this is disabled.

galaxy_setting.name: CapturableRepositioning_MinGravwellDistance
galaxy_setting.description:
What is minimum distance from the gravity well capturables are relocated to? Note that this is for the default gravwell size of 52k diameter, and will modify accordingly for larger or smaller planets. Additionally, as positioning attempts are done this value may be relaxed to find viable locations.
The default is 500, potentially going from 0 to 20000.

galaxy_setting.name: CapturableRepositioning_MaxGravwellDistance
galaxy_setting.description:
What is maximum distance from the gravity well capturables are relocated to? Note that this is for the default gravwell size of 52k diameter, and will modify accordingly for larger or smaller planets. Additionally, as positioning attempts are done this value may be relaxed to find viable locations. Additinally it will be at least 500 more than the 最小重力井距离 setting above.
The default is 7500, potentially going from 500 to 26000.

galaxy_setting.name: CapturableRepositioning_MinWormholeDistance
galaxy_setting.description:
What is minimum distance from all wormholes capturables are relocated to? Note that this is for the default gravwell size of 52k diameter, and will modify accordingly for larger or smaller planets. Additionally, as positioning attempts are done this value may be relaxed to find viable locations. Additinally it will be at least 500 more than the 最小重力井距离 setting above.
The default is 10000, potentially going from 0 to 20000.

galaxy_setting.name: CapturableRepositioning_AffectAsteroidMines
galaxy_setting.description:
If enabled asteroid mines or asteroid mining powerplants will also be affected by the repositioning logic Note that this setting does not affect Lost Energy Reactors or Abandoned Asteroid Mines.
By default this is disabled.
